subject.title: fix(agents): prevent canceled and timed-out runs from staying stuck

question: Should this protected lifecycle repair proceed only after a redacted, inspectable Gateway interruption artifact proves release and next-message admission on the rebased head?
rationale: The patch direction is coherent, but the contributor's PR-body assertions do not themselves show the claimed real runtime behavior, and the protected maintainer label requires explicit human handling.

options.title: Require inspectable interruption proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, runtime logs, a recording, or a linked artifact that shows an abort or timeout becomes terminal and a subsequent message succeeds on the rebased head.

options.title: Accept the reported Testbox scenarios
options.body: A maintainer may accept the stated remote validation without an artifact, explicitly owning the remaining session-recovery and teardown-proof gap.
